FN-JMZ6NFF-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 171
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Rodger Smitherman
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/05/2024
Senate Bill 171 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the local board
of education in a Class 1 municipality to notify parents or legal guardians of students enrolled in
and assigned to attend a priority school of the options available to apply to magnet schools, or
other public schools with competitive admissions requirements within the district; as well as a
list of the magnet schools or schools with competitive admissions requirements within the
district that a student assigned to a priority school may enroll pursuant to the Alabama
Accountability Act.
